subject: Three travelers standing before a doorway of pale light burning in a bare green hillside at dusk: a lean athletic woman in travel leathers with a sword across her back reaching toward the light, a sharply dressed woman with a silver-topped cane watching sidelong, and a young mage in a patched coat with one glowing hand raised; the doorway has no frame and no hinges, it is simply a wound of light in the grass and earth, spilling white-gold radiance across the slope; long shadows, heather and standing stones, gathering storm sky

The instant of passing between worlds: a woman mid-stride dissolving from medieval travel leathers into a rain-slick armored coat, her sword becoming a rifle in her hand, her silhouette caught half in green hillside daylight and half in the neon downpour of a night city street; glowing tattoos blaze along her forearms as the change takes hold; motion blur, streaking light, reflected neon on wet asphalt, two worlds torn together down the center of the frame

Three travelers newly arrived in a rain-drenched neon city alley at night, looking up at a vast holographic advertisement of a dragon coiling above the rooftops; their clothing has become long synthetic coats and hard boots, and faint luminous tattoos show at their wrists and throats; puddles mirror the signage in pink and cyan, steam rises from a grate, a distant airship passes between towers; cinematic wide shot, deep atmospheric perspective
